patch_description: Replace the two central CRZ gates in the reverse chain with CRX gates sharing a single parameter. This introduces X-axis entanglement capability at the circuit's core (qubits 2-4) while maintaining parameter efficiency. The axis-varied entanglement pattern (Z-axis for outer links [7,6], [6,5], [5,4], [1,0] and X-axis for inner links [4,3], [3,2]) may enhance expressivity and improve test generalization by providing more diverse rotation mechanisms without parameter bloat.
